connector.standoffs: Four M3 insulating supports; set washers to actual seated connector height; do not force nominal11mm spacers. No stand-off on UNO H11.

mcus.caveat: PGA and Core use different pin identity/orientation; solder male pins downward with jig, confirm3.5..4.5mm engagement and bottoming on first sample. FPC exits Core upper-right; reserve lateral access.
mcus.soldering: Solder from carrier underside; terminal flange2.032mm is slightly wider than1.90mm copper pad. Verify fabrication hole tolerance and first sample wetting.

ym.socket: 40pin DIP15.24mm wide; verify real socket and IC seatedheight

power_sensitivity.caveat: Assumed-length sensitivity only, not a verified longest-path bound or power-mesh analysis. Excludes contact/cable and narrow SMT escapes. Verify loadedYM21pin4.75..5.25V; never raise unloadedYM above5.25V.

compatibility: GPIO/pin-net and existing firmware/HOST source hashes unchanged; runtime P2 port pending
limitations: Generic shield overhang not guaranteed beyond declared envelope
Connector post lengths/insertion depth, tails, socket height and FPC clearance require sample fit
LDO thermal, 5V IR drop, ADC transients and mixed audio balance require measurement
No hotplug, no USB power backfeed, no fabrication approval
